audit.why: Early lane favours Garen (Q silence + E before Darkness Rise ramps); from 6 onward Mordekaiser owns the 1v1. Existing early/mid/late text states this accurately.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagrees with the packet: content win[5] and full phases[5] say 'Skill' at First item, but the packet levelChart has Mordekaiser at that stage, and the whys text already describes him winning it.
audit.why: Riftmaker burn plus Indestructible (W) healing outlasts Garen's Judgment rotation at first item; the chart row contradicted its own why-text and the packet.
audit.corrected: First item flips to Mordekaiser, rating 3/10 from Garen's side, matching the Level 6 and 2+ items rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fabricated ability name 'Mordekaiser Death Realm (R)' used repeatedly; the real name is Realm of Death. The ultimate cooldown was stated as 110s.
audit.why: Riot kit data gives R = Realm of Death at 140/120/100s, Q = Obliterate (8/7/6/5/4s), E = Death's Grasp pull (16/14/12/10/8s), W = Indestructible (12/11/10/9/8s), P = Darkness Rise. Garen's Q silence denies casts, so it is the tool that shuts off Obliterate and Death's Grasp; his W gives tenacity and damage reduction on a 22s rank-1 cooldown.
audit.corrected: Use Realm of Death and its true 140/120/100s cooldown; name Obliterate and Darkness Rise where the text said 'isolated Q slams, and passive'.

audit.why: The flagged missing interaction is anti-heal timing versus Indestructible (W). The itemization report already prescribes Executioner's Calling first back and Mortal Reminder third, so the gap is covered.
